playbookCommonFailures: Payroll data received after the 7th so the return and payment are late (10% penalty)
UIF capped incorrectly (contribution ceiling) or SDL declared when payroll is under the R500k exemption
Employee tax numbers / ID numbers missing so the later EMP501 will not reconcile
ETI claimed for employees who do not qualify
Client pays a different amount from what was declared, creating an unallocated payment on the statement of account

informationToProvide.label: Company Name
informationToProvide.aiHint: Registered company name as on the SARS profile with the PAYE reference number (7…), and UIF/SDL numbers if separate.

informationToProvide.label: Monthly payroll data (salaries, deductions, benefits)
alternatives: Spreadsheet of gross pay per employee
informationToProvide.aiHint: Payroll run for the month: gross remuneration, fringe benefits, allowances, PAYE, UIF and SDL per employee. If payroll is run in AI Payroll, pull the EMP201 report from there instead.

informationToProvide.label: Previous EMP201 submissions and payment confirmations (for new clients)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Last filed EMP201 and proof of payment — for continuity and to catch unallocated payments.

informationToProvide.label: Bank statements reflecting payment of statutory contributions
informationToProvide.aiHint: Statement showing the previous month's PAYE payment to SARS, used to reconcile the statement of account.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect eFiling access and monthly payroll data
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Credentials and the month's payroll data (or AI Payroll run) on file
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Ask for the month's payroll before the 5th so filing and payment are in time for the 7th. Name the data needed: gross pay per employee, benefits, PAYE, UIF, SDL. Do not promise a turnaround shorter than 1–2 working days.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify payroll data and the return period
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Payroll totals reconcile per employee; EMP201 for the month is issued on eFiling
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check the month on eFiling (Returns → EMP201). Check UIF is 1% employee + 1% employer up to the ceiling (⚠ verify current ceiling), SDL only if annual payroll > R500k, and every employee has an ID and tax number. Flag new employees not yet registered for tax.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Calculate PAYE, UIF, SDL and ETI
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: EMP201 totals produced from AI Payroll and reviewed by Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Pull the EMP201 report from the AI Payroll module for the month: PAYE per tax tables, UIF, SDL, ETI (only for qualifying employees — Kevin confirms eligibility). Total liability = PAYE + UIF + SDL − ETI. ⚠ verify current tax tables and ETI rules.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft payroll computation and EMP201 handoff sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Handoff sheet lists PAYE, SDL, UIF, ETI and total payable for the month
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Include the number of employees and the due date (7th of the following month, or the preceding business day ⚠ verify).

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Complete and submit the EMP201 on eFiling
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: EMP201 submitted; confirmation and PRN saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Returns → EMP201 → select the month. Enter PAYE, SDL, UIF, ETI from the handoff sheet; check the total. Agent drives to the summary; Kevin reviews and presses Submit and captures the PRN. eFiling login from a new device/IP triggers an OTP to the taxpayer's registered cell/email: pause, raise an otpRequest on the portal job via the OTP relay (Kevin, or the client through the Communication History link if allowed), 10-minute timeout then fail cleanly and reschedule. Never store OTPs. If a CAPTCHA appears, fall back to hand-off mode with the handoff sheet. Prefer filing from our practitioner profile if the taxpayer is already linked as a client; otherwise use the client's own login. If the taxpayer is not registered for the tax type on eFiling, stop and raise a proposal — do not activate tax types without Kevin.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver confirmation and payment instructions
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Filed EMP201, PRN, amount and due date posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Give the amount, the PRN and the due date; explain payment must use the PRN so it allocates to the month. Keep a copy in the client's records for the EMP501 reconciliation. No deadline threats.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
